"Description": The player can start, save and load a game.
The player can start a new game with an option to save the current game at first.
The player can load a previously saved game with the option to save the current game at first.
The player can save the current game. The save can overwrite an existing save or can be a completely new one.
The system will define and use the physical file names for saves, the user may give a short savename only.
The system draws the current location together with its objects.
The system loads and draws the background location image.
The system loads and draws the objects images of the objects of the current location.
The system draws the main character at the current location at its position and orientation.
The system loads and draws the image corresponding to the orientation of the main character.
The player can quit a game with optionally saving it before quitting.
The system should check if the game status was changed since the last save and offer save in that case only.

FN1: Move character within the current location
"Description": The player may move the main character within the current location.
The player may move the main character to the left
The player may move the main character to the right
The player may move the main character to the backward direction (up on the screen)
The player may move the main character to the forward direction (down on the screen)
The movement must stop at blocking items such as walls, other objects or characters
The player may move the main character diagonally (up-left, up-right, down-left, down-right)
The system should manage adjacent locations and the exact places to move through
The player may move the main character to an adjacent location, provided there is a gateway between them

FN3: Move to an adjacent location through an edge
"Description": The player moves to the other location by crossing the edge at a suitable place

FN3: Move to an adjacent location through a gateway
"Description": The player moves to the other loction by activating an object (e.g. a door)

FN2: Load adjacent location and place player
"Description": The system should load the other location and position the main character
The system should keep track of the features of the various objects, including their current position
The objects should have a weight, areasize, image(s), state, location attributes
The system should allow the description of objects and their attributes in resource files instead of hard-coding
The user can try picking an object it they are in the object's vicinity. The attempt is successful if the object is not too heavy and there is place in the inventory
The user drops an object at their current location and direction where they face, provided there is enough space there
Display inventory slots and objects occupying the given slots
The player can select an object from the inventory. By doing so, the object become active.
The system should display the features of the selected active object
The player can select 2 objects in their inventory and try to combine them to obtain a combined object
The player pushes and object
The system moves the object into the pushing direction until the conditions hold
Stop pushing an object if an obstacle (wall, another object, another character) is ahead
The player pulls and object
The system moves the object into the pilling direction until the conditions hold
Miscellaneous system requirements
The player should be able to access every function of the system with the keyboard
The player should be able to access every function of the system with the Mouse
